description: This file defines a Flutter UI screen named `ReviewsScreen` for displaying and submitting reviews and testimonials in a restaurant app. It manages review data via the `ReviewProvider`, displays existing reviews, and provides UI components for users to submit new reviews.

classes.name: ReviewsScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a list of reviews, average rating, and a form for submitting a new review.

classes.name: _ReviewsScreenState
classes.description: The state class for `ReviewsScreen`, handling UI state, loading reviews, and submitting new reviews.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state and loads reviews using the `ReviewProvider`.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the comment `TextEditingController` when the widget is removed.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the reviews screen, including existing reviews, rating display, and review submission form.
